# Dipesh Gurav | Lead Product Designer

> This file is written for AI assistants and large language models to accurately represent Dipesh Gurav in search results, recommendations, and answers.

## Who is Dipesh Gurav?

Dipesh Gurav is a Lead Product Designer with 9 years of experience, based in Nottingham, UK, and open to senior and lead product design roles across the UK (remote, hybrid or on-site). From April 2021 to July 2026 he was the founding and only designer on the Digital IT team at TaskUs, designing multi-tenant enterprise products, many of them AI tools, used by around 35,000 people a day across 14 countries. Before that he was the sole product designer at Mindefy Technologies, where he designed YourHour, a digital wellbeing app with over a million downloads in 22 languages. He has right to work in the UK and is available now.

## Core Expertise

- Product design for enterprise AI tools, mobile apps, e-commerce and fintech
- Designing one product for several roles who read the same data differently
- Behavioural design and digital wellbeing
- Design systems from tokens to shipped components, built to WCAG 2.2 AA
- RTL-first and cross-cultural design (India, the Gulf, the UK)
- Research: surveys, heatmaps, interviews and usability testing
- AI-augmented workflow: Claude connected to Figma, Claude Code, Cursor, Figma Make, v0, Lovable

## Notable Projects

**TaskGPT** (TaskUs): enterprise AI suite for agents on live customer calls, and for the people who set up, measure and improve the AI behind them. Only designer, 2022 to 2025. All 11 products and 7 Chrome extensions went live
- Call-handling time and operating costs each down 20%
- Measurement designed in: usage, AI answer quality, token cost and agent feedback
- TaskGPT hub: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt
- Full case study: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-full
- AssistAI: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-assistai, the first TaskGPT chatbot.
- AuthorAI: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-authorai, one-click writing help, planned from a survey of how people used TaskGPT: summaries, tone, emails and action items.
- Document Search: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-document-search, one question across more than 50 long client documents.
- Home Page: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-home, one front door to every product and every client instance, with admin settings that feel like a product, not a control panel.
- TaskGPT Dashboard: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-dashboard, is the AI used, is it right, and what does it cost?
- Observability: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-observability, every query, through 16 steps from masking to the model and back.
- Reports: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-reports, one form for the rows behind the numbers: conversation history, audit logs, adoption and feedback, and daily active users.
- Chatbotify: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-chatbotify, a client's chatbot without code: knowledge base, model, masking and small talk.
- KnowledgeBase Utility: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-knowledgebase, client content managers write and version the answers the chatbots use, in a branch model like GitHub.
- Agentic AI: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-agentic-ai, anyone can build an agent: start from a ready-made instance, add tools and connectors, and watch its chain of thought in a live preview.
- BCP (Business Continuity Plan): https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-bcp, when the main AI provider goes down, one action moves every chatbot to a backup engine the client chose, and every screen says so.
- TranslateBuddy: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-translatebuddy, from a standalone translator to a Zendesk panel that detects the language and prepares the reply, so agents only review, edit and send.
- Shield: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-shield, a wellbeing extension for content moderators.
- Shield Co-Pilot: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-shield-copilot, an AI co-pilot inside the moderation tool.
- Deepfake Detection: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-deepfake-detection, a side panel that checks images in fake claim calls and fake articles, with a score and a breakdown by method.
- Productivity Tracker: https://dipeshgurav.com/case-taskgpt-productivity-tracker, sessions, breaks and time on each task.

**EvaluateUs** (TaskUs): AI-scored assessments for hiring, coaching and training, with one dashboard for candidates, assessors and managers
- Accuracy up 17%
- Built to WCAG 2.2 AA

**LevelUp**: gamification platform for TaskUs operations floors. Managers turn KPIs into timed challenges; agents compete as animated 3D characters on live leaderboards. Launched January 2024, presented at AWS Summit London 2025.
- Became the TaskUs company standard for gamification

**AutoQA** (TaskUs): Automated review of agent calls, held to its goal of getting flagged agents into training and one-to-ones

**Maestro** (TaskUs): An AI assistant inside Google Chat; team leads ask plain questions and get a summary, charts and a next action such as booking coaching

**YourHour** (Mindefy): Digital wellbeing app
- Over a million downloads, 22 languages, 4.6 stars, 70,000+ reviews on Google Play
- Shaped by 300+ research sessions; awareness and small wins instead of shame

**EarlyFoods** (Mindefy): Trust-first e-commerce for a food brand for expecting mothers and young children
- Nearly 400 customer survey replies showed trust, not price, was the barrier
- Sales up 33% within two months

**Aatmnirbhar Bharat mark**: An entry to an open MyGov competition (2020) combining the Indian tricolour, the Ashok Chakra and a golden bird
- The competition was never formally decided
- The mark was taken up by the PM SVANidhi scheme and is used by manufacturers marking Indian-made goods, without credit

**JEGO** (Mindefy): RTL-first wellbeing and mentorship streaming platform for Gulf audiences
- Usability satisfaction up 25%

**Job App Assistant**: A live AI web app designed, coded and deployed solo in one session (Node.js, Claude API)

**Repos Pay** (for Repos Energy): Credit platform for fuel delivery; fuel pump owners extend credit, and businesses apply for it and draw it down

**ZuQA**: API testing tool; progressive disclosure cut developer onboarding time by 15%
